decision.rationale: Post-Pilot #20 Reliability v2 Q1-Q7 are PASS on the approved candidate-recovery implementation lineage. The candidate-aware bounded Q7 soak accepted all 20 governed Assessment Item and Marking Pack samples across all five subject shapes, accurately distinguished ten targeted repairs from one fresh candidate resample, and recorded no infrastructure incident or engineering-boundary breach. Q8 may therefore restore confirmation-pilot eligibility without changing worker/compiler logic or weakening educational assurance.

limitations: Q8 restores execution eligibility only; it does not prove educational correctness, expert-review approval or publication readiness.
This Q8 transition does not itself dispatch a provider run, assemble a course or publish learner content.
The next paid run class is one bounded confirmation pilot using the same qualification evidence; it is not triggered by this change.
A confirmation pilot may still fail closed for educational findings, provider/infrastructure incidents or a new generic engineering contract class.
A new generic engineering contract class must return global qualification to paused and restart the affected Reliability v2 gates.
The US$20 per-course ceiling and source-rights, independent-review, expert-review and publication controls remain unchanged.
Content Factory maturity still requires three consecutive materially different real courses to reach expert_review_ready without engineering or worker-contract correction between runs.
